messages:
Alex: :rotating_light: Observability gap during eu-west2 failover — GPU node pool went unhealthy but node-level GPU metrics are missing from prometheus. not seeing node_gpu_util or nvml_exporter metrics.
Maria: Confirmed. kubectl top nodes shows pods running but prometheus targets page doesn't list nvml-exporter for eu-west2.
Jin: I saw alerts for provisioner capacity but the autoscaler didn't trigger because the horizontal-pod-autoscaler metric namespace was empty. looks like a scrape misconfig.
Alex: OpsBot reported instance provisioning, but no telemetry for the new nodes. OpsBot: Instance provision started for pool-eu-gpu-2 (i-0a1b2c3d).
Maria: Poking the prometheus config: the relabel for region_label got renamed in the last helm values change. snippet:
```
- job_name: 'node-exporter'
  static_configs:
  - targets: ['${NODE_HOST}:9100']
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ['__meta_kubernetes_node_label_region']
    target_label: 'region'
```
We used `region` previously but target changed to `cloud_region` in recent diff. so eu-west2 targets filtered out by the scrape job selector.
Jin: ah. that explains why the autoscaler and gpu exporter metrics were invisible to alerting. will that also affect the kv-cache shard metrics?
SRE-Lead: Yes — any downstream alerts that depend on region label will drop. We lost per-region dashboards and some fallback routing couldn't detect degraded capacity.
Maria: Quick mitigation: I'll patch prometheus helm release to add a catch-all relabel to map both labels. running: `helm upgrade prometheus -f values.yml prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack --namespace monitoring`
Alex: While Maria patches, we should shift inference traffic off eu-west2. Jin, can you update the smart-routing policy to divert to us-west1 and us-east1? include capacity thresholds.
Jin: On it. updating routing policy: `redwoodctl routing set --region-priority us-west1,us-east1 --fallback-capacity 0.6` Rolling now. DeployBot: routing-policy v2 -> v3 rollout started by Jin.
TelemetryBot: Detected 87% drop in node_gpu_util metrics for eu-west2 at 1802456805. Alert suppressed due to missing labels.
Maria: Helm upgrade completed, added relabel mapping and reenabled nvml exporter relabels. prometheus targets page shows nvml-exporter (eu-west2) back online.
Alex: Nice — can someone validate autoscaler metrics are now present? `curl -sS http://prometheus.monitoring/api/v1/query?query=node_gpu_util` returns values?
Jin: Query returning values for eu-west2 now. HPA started a scale-up to recover capacity.
SRE-Lead: Follow-up action: create a unit test in our prometheus config CI that fails if node-level exporter jobs don't include either region or cloud_region labels. open an RFC for safer label renames.
Maria: Filing PR for CI check and a postmortem note. will include exact failing relabel diff.
Alex: Also we need a short-term cost note: diverting 40% traffic to on-demand us-west1 may add ~15% infra spend this month. Finance FYI.
Jin: I adjusted batch job schedules to free GPU headroom; will revert after capacity stabilizes.
SRE-Lead: Postmortem owners: Maria (instrumentation), Jin (routing/fallback), Alex (comms + cost). schedule follow-up 1hr post-incident to capture timeline.
Maria: Done — will include the prometheus config diff and the helm values that caused the rename.
Alex: Thanks team. leaving this thread open until metrics and traffic are stable. :white_check_mark:
